ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pigmentation background (~80-85%) interspersed with high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters (~15-20%) creating a high global contrast profile.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation across both lobes. Significant spatial mapping of white high-contrast circular rings (rosettes) distributed throughout, with a distinct concentration of white pixels at the far left lateral edge and lower central sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression; the angle of divergence between the lobes is approximately 110 degrees with a clear pixel-depth recession into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations. Sharp peaks and deep valleys are visible along the entire boundary from the median notch to both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a straight diagonal trajectory toward the pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, widespread distribution of high-contrast white circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters (barnacle scars) across the entire visible ventral surface; specifically prominent in the mid-section and trailing edge regions of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several visible thin, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions; notably a vertical mark on the right lobe near the median notch and multiple smaller diagonal scratches on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarification across the surface. A distinct small reddish/brown protrusion or piece of debris is visible attached to the far right distal tip of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: The highly dense and overlapping nature of the white circular ring patterns creates a unique 'honeycomb' or 'bubble' texture against the black background pigmentation.
